name: @bugsee/otel3-compat
description: Runs @bugsee/opentelemetry against a REAL @opentelemetry/sdk-trace@3 (OpenTelemetry JS 3.x). Separate from the package itself because sdk-trace@3 peers @opentelemetry/api >=1.10 <1.11 while sdk-trace-base@2 (the package's own devDependency) peers <1.10: one workspace package cannot satisfy both. Node >=22.15 only (OTel 3's engines floor); the suite skips cleanly below it.
